title: The planner's answer gets each missing maxCharacters from the kit before the plan check, so R06 sends no fix round for it
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: On the JA Boxing kit, a plan whose kept copy entries (a block's own and its list rows') leave maxCharacters out or null fails R06 before the planner step reads it, and passes every rule after; the filled plan equals the plan with the limits written by hand, and the answer is not modified in place.

A maxCharacters the plan gives is kept (one above the kit limit still fails R06); a slot the kit gives no limit, a hidden block and a dropped page are left alone; the plan a fix round's change list leaves gets the same limits.

tests: a copy entry without maxCharacters gets the kit limit R06 reads, and the plan passes every rule
a number the plan gives is kept, so R06 still fails one above the kit limit
a slot the kit gives no limit, a hidden block and a dropped page are left alone
the plan a fix round change list leaves gets the same limits
